record.field: Export records from any Odoo model as a file attached to this conversation. Use when the user asks to export, download, or get a spreadsheet of records. If the user mentioned specific fields (e.g. "name, phone, address"), extract and pass them as the fields list (e.g. ["name", "phone", "street"]). If no fields are mentioned, omit the fields argument and all stored scalar fields will be exported. Specify the model technical name (e.g. 'res.partner', 'product.template'), a domain filter if the user mentioned a subset, a limit matching what the user asked for, and a format (default 'csv').
